research_reports.title: BTC Scalping Strategy Replication
research_reports.subtitle: Review of the claimed 91.67% BTCUSD.V win-rate screenshot

verdict.label: Not Replicable
verdict.summary: The claimed 91.67% win rate does not hold up under realistic market data, cost accounting, and repeatable backtesting.

key_findings: Only 2 of 12 trades matched real BTC market data.
The outlier 1,737-point move did not occur in real BTC price history.
Reported P/L excluded exchange costs, adding roughly $216-$324 in hidden fees.
The 4-second pyramid strongly implies automation rather than manual execution.
The practical replacement is VWAP Scalper Pro with a 60-75% target win-rate range.

review_findings.title: Intermediate deliverables contradict the final verdict
review_findings.detail: Several exploratory files still claim the 91.67% result is achievable, but the final investigation, backtest, and practical strategy all conclude the screenshot is not reproducible on real data.

review_findings.title: Best observed backtest still missed the headline claim
review_findings.detail: The strongest backtest run reached 40.00% win rate, still below the claimed 91.67%.

research_reports.recommended_next_step: Use FINAL_INVESTIGATION_REPORT.txt and FINAL_STRATEGY.txt as the source of truth; treat the microstructure replication files as exploratory dead ends.
